items.name: upper arm blood pressure monitor
items.note: Devices used in diagnosing and treating illness are includible.

items.name: compression socks 15-20 mmHg
items.note: Not named in the sources; compression garments treat circulatory conditions but are also worn for comfort or sport. Eligible only for a medical condition.

items.name: HEPA air purifier
items.note: Equipment whose main purpose is medical care is includible; for an ordinary household air purifier that purpose must be documented by a physician.

items.name: multi-purpose contact lens solution, 12 oz
items.note: Equipment and materials required for using contact lenses, such as saline solution and enzyme cleaner, are includible.

items.name: toilet safety rail
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.name: diet frozen entree
items.note: Diet food and beverages aren't includible because they substitute for what is normally eaten.

items.name: stainless steel grab bar, 24 in
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.

items.name: electric heating pad, XL
items.note: Sources don't name them; heat and cold packs are equipment for treating an injury but also have ordinary uses. Eligible only when used to treat a condition.

items.name: gauze pads 4x4 in, 25 count
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: overnight maxi pads, 28 count
items.note: Menstrual care products (tampon, pad, liner, cup, sponge or similar) are treated as medical care for HSAs, FSAs and HRAs after 2019.
